'''January 2001 Fargo tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Fargo, North Dakota on 6 January 2001. It is known from Jeff Kasper's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1589">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-06-fargo-nd-1-6-01d1589/ fargo-nd-1-6-01], DeckTech (jeff "kazper" kasper, 6 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-06-fargo-nd-1-6-01d1589/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Fargo, North Dakota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
